lead.zh: 一句话概括：数据是"对现实的一次采样"，你选择怎么采样，决定了后面能问什么问题。
lead.en: In one line: data is a sampling of reality, and how you sample decides what questions you can ask later.

points.zh: DIKW 四个层次里，可视化的主战场是「数据 → 信息」这一段：把原始记录变成人能读懂的描述。
points.en: Of the four DIKW tiers, visualization mainly works on “data → information”: turning raw records into something readable.

points.zh: 数据质量看四件事：完整性、准确性、一致性、时效性。缺一项，后面所有图都是错的。
points.en: Data quality rests on four things: completeness, accuracy, consistency, timeliness. Miss one and every chart downstream is wrong.

points.zh: Stevens 四尺度（名义 / 序数 / 区间 / 比率）决定了数据允许做哪些运算：名义数据算平均没有意义。
points.en: Stevens’ four scales (nominal / ordinal / interval / ratio) decide which operations are legal: averaging nominal data is meaningless.

points.zh: 视觉通道分三档：定量型（位置、长度、角度）、顺序型（亮度、密度）、定性型（色相、形状）。尺度与通道必须匹配。
points.en: Channels come in three tiers: quantitative (position, length, angle), ordered (brightness, density), qualitative (hue, shape). Scale and channel must match.

points.zh: D3 的数据变换八函数是「数据 → 数据表」的全部工具箱；判断标准是「只改行结构」还是「产生新数值」。
points.en: The eight D3 transforms are the whole toolbox for “data → table”; the test is whether a function reshapes rows or produces new numbers.

points.zh: Data-Join 三态（enter / update / exit）按「数据与元素能否配对」划分，只写 enter 会导致删数据时旧元素残留。
points.en: The Data-Join triad (enter / update / exit) is decided by whether a datum can pair with a node; handling only enter leaves stale nodes behind.

lead.zh: 一句话概括：可视化是一条有明确站点的流水线，出问题时先定位是哪一站出的错。
lead.en: In one line: visualization is a pipeline with named stations — when something breaks, first find which station failed.

points.zh: Card 数据流模型：原数据 → 数据表 → 视觉结构 → 视图。每一步的输入输出都有类型，这是能按步排查的前提。
points.en: The Card data-flow model: raw data → data table → visual structure → view. Every step has typed input and output, which is what makes step-by-step debugging possible.

points.zh: Shneiderman 箴言：概览优先 → 缩放过滤 → 按需细节。这三句是交互设计的默认骨架。
points.en: Shneiderman’s mantra: overview first → zoom and filter → details on demand. These three phrases are the default skeleton for interaction.

points.zh: 视觉编码承接第 1 章：先确定测量尺度，再选通道，顺序反了就会出现「拿色相编码数值」这类误用。
points.en: Visual mapping builds on Chapter 1: fix the measurement scale first, then pick the channel; reversing the order produces misuses such as encoding values with hue.

points.zh: Reingold-Tilford 布局让树「不重叠又紧凑」，是层级数据可视化的经典算法。
points.en: The Reingold-Tilford layout keeps a tree non-overlapping yet compact — the classic algorithm for hierarchical data.

points.zh: DOM 事件分捕获 / 目标 / 冒泡三阶段。事件委托（监听父节点）是图表交互的标准做法，比给每个元素绑监听器更稳。
points.en: DOM events run through capture / target / bubble. Event delegation (listening on the parent) is the standard for chart interaction and steadier than one listener per element.

lead.zh: 一句话概括：配色不是审美问题，而是"能不能读准"的问题——先问数据有没有顺序，再选方案。
lead.en: In one line: color is about readability, not taste — first ask whether the data is ordered, then choose.

points.zh: 三个颜色空间各有分工：RGB 存与显示、HSL 手动挑色、Lab 做感知评估。
points.en: Three color spaces, three jobs: RGB for storage and display, HSL for hand-picking, Lab for perceptual evaluation.

points.zh: 「感知均匀」只有一条判据：相等的数值差要看起来也相等。所以不要拿 RGB 两端直接插值。
points.en: “Perceptually uniform” has exactly one test: equal value steps must look like equal steps. Hence never interpolate straight through RGB.

points.zh: colormap 三类：顺序型（单调数据）、发散型（有中点）、定性型（无序类别）。没有顺序就必须用定性型。
points.en: Three colormap families: sequential (monotonic), diverging (meaningful midpoint), categorical (unordered). No order means categorical.

points.zh: 顺序型与发散型要保证亮度单调，这样黑白打印与色觉缺陷读者也能读懂。
points.en: Sequential and diverging maps need monotonic lightness so they survive grayscale printing and colour-vision deficiency.

points.zh: 五大色系规则（同类 / 邻近 / 互补 / 分裂互补 / 三角）解决的是「看起来是一套」而不是「好看」。
points.en: The five harmony rules (monochromatic / analogous / complementary / split / triadic) make a palette look like one family, not merely pretty.

points.zh: 约 8% 的男性有某种色觉缺陷，所以颜色永远要有冗余编码（形状、直接标注、明暗差）。
points.en: About 8% of men have some colour-vision deficiency, so color always needs a redundant encoding (shape, direct labels, lightness).

lead.zh: 一句话概括：低维数据可视化的难点不在"画出来"，而在"画得准"——坐标要对、曲线要诚实、读图要符合人眼。
lead.en: In one line: the hard part of low-dimensional visualization is not drawing it, but drawing it truthfully — correct axes, honest curves, human-readable slopes.

points.zh: 三层坐标空间：数据空间 → 坐标系空间 → 屏幕空间。把三层的职责混在一行表达式里，是这类图最常见的 bug 来源。
points.en: Three coordinate layers: data space → coordinate space → screen space. Mixing their responsibilities in one expression is the most common source of bugs.

points.zh: SVG 的 y 轴向下，所以垂直方向要写 y = height − scale(v)。
points.en: SVG’s y axis points down, so vertical positions need y = height − scale(v).

points.zh: 平滑有代价：curveBasis 甚至不经过数据点。要保真就用 linear，要平滑且不造假峰就用 monotone。
points.en: Smoothing costs fidelity: curveBasis does not even pass through the data points. Use linear for fidelity, monotone when smoothing must not invent peaks.

points.zh: Cleveland 45°：平均斜率接近 45° 时，人判断"差多少"最准；纵轴压得太扁会让人读不出变化。
points.en: Cleveland 45°: accuracy judging magnitude peaks when the average slope is near 45°; a squashed y-axis hides change.

points.zh: Marching Squares：等值线 = 网格边上找内外交界 + 连线段，不做曲线拟合。
points.en: Marching Squares: a contour = edge crossings found per cell, then joined — no curve fitting involved.

points.zh: 这一章的四种图都在回答同一个问题：怎么把"连续场"画成人能读的形式。
points.en: All four idioms in this chapter answer one question: how to draw a continuous field in a form people can read.

lead.zh: 一句话概括：时间是"一维但五属性"的通道——先认清要表达哪个属性，画法自然就出来了。
lead.en: In one line: time is one dimension with five attributes — identify which attribute matters and the idiom follows.

points.zh: 时间的五个属性：有序、连续、周期、独立于空间、结构性。属性决定画法，不是先选图再找数据。
points.en: Five attributes of time: ordered, continuous, periodic, space-independent, structured. The attribute picks the idiom, not the other way round.

points.zh: 「有序」→ 折线；「连续」→ 连续轴上的密度/高度；「周期」→ 日历热图或极坐标螺旋；「结构性」→ 时间轴逐级下钻。
points.en: Ordered → line; continuous → density or height on a continuous axis; periodic → calendar heatmap or polar spiral; structured → drill down the axis.

points.zh: 日历热图的威力在两个轴都放时间（周 × 星期几），周期性因此一眼可见；代价是格子小、只适合看模式。
points.en: A calendar heatmap works because both axes carry time (week × weekday), making periodicity visible; the cost is tiny cells, good only for patterns.

points.zh: 螺旋把周期「卷起来」，让年度周期头尾相接；代价是不同圈会重叠，需要靠透明度 / 颜色区分圈次。
points.en: A spiral wraps the cycle so annual periods meet head to tail; turns overlap, so opacity or color must separate them.

points.zh: Storyline 用「实体线 + 事件 + 时间」讲关系随时间变化的故事，适合有角色的叙事型数据。
points.en: A storyline uses entity lines plus events over time to tell how relationships change — good for narrative data with actors.

points.zh: 换粒度就是换问题：按日看噪声、按周看趋势、按月看季节，同一份数据三种回答。
points.en: Changing granularity changes the question: daily shows noise, weekly shows trend, monthly shows seasonality — one dataset, three answers.
